lines.text: After Israel enters the land, each burnt offering or sacrifice from herd or flock needs flour, oil, and wine.
A foreigner who prepares a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD does exactly as Israel does.
Throughout their generations, the Israelites must lift up a cake from the first of their wine as a contribution.
When the congregation sins unintentionally, they bring one young bull and one male lamb, and the priest makes atonement.
The person who sins defiantly blasphemes the LORD and will be cut off from his people.
